items.title: Henry Russ Interview, 1972-01-18
items.q: Lawrence Charler was playing drums. Buddy Charles was playing guitar. Uh, who else was playing? I think, the compass playing guitar. Yeah, the compass. I was secretary, I don't know, right secretary, everybody, yeah. Peace band. Well, I kept that band about it

ctx.x: Must have been a bit of a big deal to broadcast then.

Well, he was making money, but we wasn't making but a dollar and forty cents a night. That's what we meant, we didn't get a dollar and forty cents a night. Which is, somewhere about 10 pips that week. Which thing was pretty tight, you know. And, uh, there they are. Somehow or other, Henry Horton and the man, got some misunderstanding between them two, I don't know what it was all about. The man got rid of Henry Horton, and the band wouldn't walk off with Henry Horton. So they turned the band over to me. Henry…
